# The Hardball Times

> > In-depth baseball writing combining sabermetrics, history, physics, and cultural analysis from FanGraphs' long-form publication.

The Hardball Times publishes thoughtful baseball essays covering statistical analysis, historical deep dives, player profiles, and the cultural dimensions of America's pastime. The site features contributions from writers like Jen Mac Ramos, Mary Craig, John Paschal, and Sarah Wexler, exploring everything from Hall of Fame debates to the physics of pitches.

## Key Topics

- Sabermetrics and baseball analytics
- Baseball Hall of Fame and Cooperstown
- Baseball history and memoirs
- Statistical analysis and modeling
- Baseball physics and technology
- Player profiles and biographies
- Baseball strategy and evolution
- Cultural and social issues in baseball
- Minor league baseball
- Umpire analysis and bias studies
- Injury prediction models
- Tracking technology (Hawk-Eye)
- Baseball podcasts
- Fan behavior and economics

## Advanced Analytics & Sabermetrics

- [Umpires Ejections and Player Ethnicity: An Analysis](https://tht.fangraphs.com/umpires-ejections-and-player-ethnicity-an-analysis): Statistical study of racial bias in umpire ejections of players
- [Improving a Starting Pitcher Injury Model With Multiple Classifier Algorithms](https://tht.fangraphs.com/improving-a-starting-pitcher-injury-model-with-multiple-classifier-algorithms): Machine learning approach to predicting pitcher injuries
- [Ending the LaRussa Orthodoxy: Part 1](https://tht.fangraphs.com/ending-the-larussa-orthodoxy-part-1): Analysis of traditional bullpen roles and closer usage patterns
- [There's Lots of Physics To Do Now That Hawk-Eye Is Up and Running](https://tht.fangraphs.com/theres-lots-of-physics-to-do-now-that-hawk-eye-is-up-and-running): Hawk-Eye tracking technology and its applications in baseball physics
- [Bases Loaded, Nobody Out — What Happens Next?](https://tht.fangraphs.com/bases-loaded-nobody-out-what-happens-next): Statistical analysis of bases-loaded situations in 2019 season
- [The Physics of Being Hit by a Pitch](https://tht.fangraphs.com/the-physics-of-being-hit-by-a-pitch): Physics analysis of hit-by-pitch impacts featuring Chase Utley

## Baseball Strategy & Culture

- [Surveying the Field: When Baseball Lets You Down](https://tht.fangraphs.com/surveying-the-field-fans-react-when-baseball-lets-them-down): Fan survey on player offensive tweets and diversity in baseball
- [Baseball's Norms, Today and Yesterday](https://tht.fangraphs.com/baseballs-norms-today-and-yesterday): Evolution of baseball strategy and managerial decisions over time
- [The Irrationalities of Baseball Fandom](https://tht.fangraphs.com/the-irrationalities-of-baseball-fandom): Behavioral economics and cognitive biases in baseball fandom
- [Bo Don't Know, Part I](https://tht.fangraphs.com/bo-dont-know-part-i): Bo Schembechler's troubled tenure as Detroit Tigers president
- [The Not-So-Private Lives of Baseball Wives](https://tht.fangraphs.com/the-not-so-private-lives-of-baseball-wives): 1930s media coverage of baseball marriages and gender roles

## Baseball History & Memoirs

- [Johnny Antonelli and Me](https://tht.fangraphs.com/johnny-antonelli-and-me): Personal memoir of boyhood hero Johnny Antonelli and 1950s NY Giants
- [The Rocky Mount Pines, a Baseball Disaster](https://tht.fangraphs.com/the-rocky-mount-pines-a-baseball-disaster): History of Rocky Mount Pines, one of worst minor league teams ever
- [Retroactive Review: A Jim Abbott Double Feature](https://tht.fangraphs.com/retroactive-review-a-jim-abbott-double-feature): Review of Jim Abbott book and documentary on one-handed pitcher
- [Space Between: The Gospel of Josh Hamilton](https://tht.fangraphs.com/space-between-the-gospel-of-josh-hamilton): Profile of Josh Hamilton's career and redemption story with Rangers

## Podcasts & Audio

- [Episode 83: From the Clubhouse to the Community](https://tht.fangraphs.com/tht-audio/episode-83-from-the-clubhouse-to-the-community): Podcast with Sean Doolittle and Eireann Dolan on advocacy and labor
- [Episode 77: Michael's Secret Stuff](https://tht.fangraphs.com/tht-audio/episode-77-michaels-secret-stuff): Podcast covering MLB trades, Hall of Fame ballot, and listener Q&A

## Optional

- [Cooperstown Confidential: The Hauntings of the Hall of Fame](https://tht.fangraphs.com/cooperstown-confidential-the-hauntings-of-the-hall-of-fame): Halloween-themed exploration of Hall of Fame supernatural stories
- [An American Dream: Kirk Gibson Is Opening a Batting Cage in Johnson City](https://tht.fangraphs.com/an-american-dream-kirk-gibson-is-opening-a-batting-cage-in-johnson-city): Kirk Gibson's batting cage venture in Johnson City, Texas
